title: companion.json
description: A Deskling companion app's facts for tools/*: names, paths (relative to the file), languages and the tool settings. tools/companion.py validates it with the subset of JSON Schema used here (type, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, enum, pattern, minItems).

name.description: Short lowercase name (repo, keychain and log prefixes).

displayName.description: The app's name as users see it.

character.description: The character's name, used in comments and review pages.

tag.description: The Deskling release the app pins everywhere.

projectSpec.description: The XcodeGen spec, relative to mac.dir.

app.description: The app target's folder, relative to mac.dir.

core.description: The core Swift package's folder, relative to mac.dir.

tests.description: The app's test target folder, relative to mac.dir.

devAppName.description: The Debug app's name (install-dev, dev icon).

screenshotEnv.description: The environment variable that starts a screenshot run.

all.description: Every language the app ships, the source included.

landing.description: The landing page's i18n folder (<lang>.json, languages.ts).

glossaryKeys.description: Catalog keys whose translations work files repeat as a glossary.

keepNames.description: Names translators keep as they are.

rulesFile.description: Markdown with the app's transcreation rules, sent with every work file.

linuxPo.description: Where export-linux writes <lang>.po, or null for no Linux port.

stringsdataFilter.description: A path fragment the app's .stringsdata files contain (default <mac.scheme>.build).

phraseComment.description: The translator comment of a phrase key: {character}, {tags}, {flavor}, {flavorNote}, {part}.

flavorNotes.description: Flavor id → what it does for the listener.

writeFlag.description: The environment variable that makes the Swift tests write the vectors.

corePackagePath.description: The Swift package whose tests generate the vectors.

design.description: The folder of skin folders (<skin>/<skin>.rig.json); character.py compiles each.

swiftOut.description: The folder that gets <Skin>Art.swift for each skin (it imports DesklingCompanion).

swiftModule.description: The app module those Swift files are compiled into, for reference.

assets.description: Raster: the asset catalog folder that gets an imageset per layer.

windowsAssets.description: Raster: the folder that gets the scale-200/300 PNGs.

moods.description: The Mood cases in order (default: the package's seven).

dir.description: The voices checkout (a submodule holding Voice/).

config.description: voice-config.json: the voice settings per language and voice.

reviewColors.description: The review pages' colors, per scheme: token (paper, card, ink, ink-soft, line, accent, accent-soft, on-accent, done, done-soft, flag, flag-soft, link) → #RRGGBB. Unset tokens keep the defaults.

siteCopyright.description: The rights sentence on the review site, after "Shared with friends who help review <character>'s voice." (default: © displayName, all rights reserved).

copyrightHolder.description: Who holds the copyright in the voices repository's LICENSE line, e.g. "2026 Jane Doe" (default: displayName).

extraClips.description: Clip id → source text of clips that aren't phrases.

required.description: Clip ids every voiced language must have before shipping.

recipes.description: A Python module defining sounds(engine) → {name: samples}, built from tools/synth.py.

required.description: Characters every shipped language needs from the face.

compose.description: Character → [base glyph, mark glyph, "above" or "below", alias characters…] to compose when missing.

noteFont.description: The note's font file (the headline's when absent).

palette.description: light/dark → {paper, ink, accent, accentText} hex colors.

tool.description: The landing page's build command (vp, npm).

guardedExtra.description: More paths (regular expressions) agents must not edit by hand.

macUI.description: A path regex for Mac UI files; editing one reminds of the Windows twin.

windowsUI.description: The same for Windows UI files.
